description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Scaretiller and another artifact, targeting Scaretiller.
Scaretiller triggers, returning Evolving Wilds from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Evolving Wilds enters the battlefield, triggering Toggo and Amulet of Vigor.
Resolve the Toggo trigger, creating a Rock equipment token.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Evolving Wilds.
Resolve the Clock of Omens ability from step 1, untapping Scaretiller.
Activate Evolving Wilds by tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to search your library for a basic land and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
If you put a land onto the battlefield this way, Toggo triggers, creating a Rock equipment token.
Repeat.
